$Comment: Ending a bounty: defeating a player whose streak of kills had put a bounty on them (the world's PvP rules, Bounty.At). Target is always Player; the Qualifier is the item you held. The amount a step counts is 1 a bounty; a track source's PerAmount reads what it is worth instead, a share of the fallen player's health for each kill in their streak (Bounty.PerKill, at most Bounty.MaxStreak kills), raised by your PvpBountyBonus stat. A step reads {"Kind": "PLAYER_BOUNTY", "Amount": 5}.
